The Heights' New Playground

Located in Houston's vibrant Heights area. Our vintage, two-story sports bar offers an old-school lodge feel, complete with charming decor and a large stuffed bear. Enjoy free pickleball, volleyball, and our spacious patio. Sip on crafted cocktails and savor delicious food in our expansive indoor and outdoor spaces. Kid-friendly until 9 PM, BLVD PARK is the perfect spot for families and friends. Experience sports, leisure, and vintage charm all in one place!

Pickleball in the Heights Just Got a Pulse

At BLVD PARK, the game is only half the story. Our blue-and-green courts are open daily and always free — no reservations, no memberships, no gatekeeping. Play covered or open-air, paddle in one hand, drink in the other. Whether you're rallying with friends or just out to vibe, the music's up, the cocktails flow, and the energy rolls from court to cabana without skipping a beat. This is how Houston does pickleball — casually competitive, socially charged, and right in the heart of the Heights.

Open daily: Sun-Thu 12PM-12AM | Fri 12PM-2AM | Sat 11AM-2AM
